name: robot-admin-packages
description: Robot Admin 可复用插拔式公共依赖包 Monorepo
author: ChenYu <ycyplus@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/theme build && bun run --cwd packages/directives build && bun run --cwd packages/file-utils build && bun run --cwd packages/form-validate build && bun run --cwd packages/request-core build && bun run --cwd packages/git-standards build && bun run --cwd packages/layout build
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/theme/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/directives/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/file-utils/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/form-validate/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/request-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/git-standards/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/layout type-check
